general.notes: BiDi pair: SO-SFP-100Base-BX20D-34 TX 1310 nm / RX 1490 nm; SO-SFP-100Base-BX20D-43 TX 1490 nm / RX 1310 nm. Transmit wavelength range BX20D-34: 1260–1360 nm; BX20D-43: 1470–1540 nm (footnote 2). Receive wavelength range BX20D-34: 1470–1540 nm; BX20D-43: 1260–1360 nm (footnote 1). Bit rate stated as 100–155.52 Mbps (not Gbps). Power budget 0–14 dB (FE) and 0–13 dB (STM1/OC3). Rx sensitivity and overload at BER ≤ 1×10⁻¹² back-to-back (footnote 4). Tx/Rx power values are average power (footnote 3). Power consumption < 1.0 W. Storage temperature −40°C to +85°C (not normal operating). DDM per SFF-8472.
